title: dioscorea alata var. globosa
intro: Dioscorea alata var. globosa, commonly known as the purple yam, is a variety of yam that belongs to the Dioscoreaceae family. It is widely cultivated for its edible tubers, which are rich in nutrients and have been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Dioscorea alata var. globosa include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as diabetes and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diosgenin, a saponin that is known for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties.
